"Local operating rules: Continuation of Cedar Tunnel X29 piling operation is permitted when Cedar Tunnel X29 vibration sensor stays below 18.2 mm/s. A reading above 18.2 mm/s on the same sensor requires stopping Cedar Tunnel X29 piling operation and notifying Cedar Tunnel X29 deputy inspector. The permitted rate for Cedar Tunnel X29 discharge is at most 905 L/min."

"Construction note — Operational guidance: Continuation of Delta Basin X30 south excavation is permitted when Delta Basin X30 vibration sensor stays below 18.8 mm/s. A reading above 18.8 mm/s on the same sensor requires stopping Delta Basin X30 south excavation and notifying Delta Basin X30 site superintendent. The permitted rate for Delta Basin X30 discharge is at most 930 L/min."
